description: Header file defining internal big integer class and constants used for decimal-to-binary conversions in the Abseil library, including class BigUnsigned with arithmetic operations and related utilities.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: A fixed-width, limited big integer class supporting arithmetic operations for decimal-to-binary conversions.

methods.name: BigUnsigned(uint64_t v)
methods.description: Constructs a BigUnsigned from a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: BigUnsigned(absl::string_view sv)
methods.description: Constructs a BigUnsigned from a decimal string view.

methods.name: ReadFloatMantissa
methods.description: Loads mantissa of a parsed float and returns its decimal exponent.

methods.name: Digits10
methods.description: Returns the number of decimal digits of precision.

methods.name: ShiftLeft
methods.description: Shifts the big integer left by a specified number of bits.

methods.name: MultiplyBy
methods.description: Multiplies the big integer by a uint32_t or uint64_t value.

methods.name: SetToZero
methods.description: Resets the big integer to zero.

methods.name: GetWord
methods.description: Returns the nth word of the big integer, range-checked.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the big integer to a decimal string.

methods.name: ReadDigits
methods.description: Reads decimal digits from a character range into the big integer, returning exponent adjustment.

methods.name: MultiplyStep
methods.description: Performs a step of big integer multiplication for internal use.
